original_conjecture_formulation: All compact complex manifolds and all smooth initial Kähler metrics; a smooth flow on [0,∞) starts from each initial metric.
initial_potential_zero: The quantified background metric itself is the arbitrary initial metric; F(0)=0 places no restriction on initial metrics.
kahler_metric_representation: Local smooth strictly plurisubharmonic potentials, Hermitian transition compatibility, and the determinant volume density; charts can be refined to admit local potentials.
equation: dF/dt = scalar curvature - initial average scalar curvature; the global potential preserves the Kähler class.
new_general_proof: Not formalized; statement-only check. Original three FC theorem placeholders are preserved.
